source_name: SNU Monsoon 2026 Timetable Planner (Netlify) - same source as 2026-08-04, reprocessed
note: Same source snapshot as monsoon-2026-netlify-revision-2026-08-04 (raw_snapshot.html, unchanged) reprocessed with a fixed build_packages(): the old cross-product ignored per-section batch tags and offered combinations mixing sections restricted to disjoint student batches as valid packages (e.g. CSD211/CSD2003 PRAC1, batch CSD21-only, + TUT2, batch CSD23/24-only). 8 of 326 courses affected, packages 988 -> 954, no courses added/removed/renamed.
